assets.description: Shore appearance for the local traveler.
assets.promptSummary: Stylized concept for a game portrait. Use the supplied image as the style and framing template. Create a distinct island traveler with a young adult woman, dark navy shoulder-length hair tied at one side, warm light brown skin, and a sea-blue scarf over an ivory and muted teal canvas jacket with a small brass clasp. Keep the friendly expression, centered head-and-shoulders bust, broad low-poly planes, soft warm light, character scale, and transparent silhouette. Leave a small margin around hair and shoulders. One character, square canvas, no writing, no frame, no scenery.
assets.import: Original transparent PNG, Single Sprite, maximum import size 512.
